edition.publication: Latin text of the constitution as printed in Denzinger's Enchiridion symbolorum, definitionum et declarationum de rebus fidei et morum, nn. 800-802 (older numbering 428-430)
edition.title: Firmiter credimus — Latin text as received in Denzinger's Enchiridion symbolorum

work.author: Fourth Lateran Council under Innocent III
work.description: The first constitution of the Fourth Lateran Council (1215), the profession of the Catholic faith opening with Firmiter credimus. It defines the one God and creator of all things visible and invisible, the Incarnation, the general resurrection in which all will rise with their own bodies which they now bear, the one universal Church outside which no one at all is saved, and transubstantiation.
work.title: Firmiter credimus
